question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Fragile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Brittle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fragile"** means something that is easily broken or damaged; delicate. (नाजुक)

 
 
• **Example: **The vase was so fragile that it shattered into pieces when it fell.
 
 
 
• **"Brittle" **refers to something that is hard but liable to break or shatter easily. (भंगुर)
 
 
• **Example: **The dry leaves were brittle and crumbled underfoot.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate meaning of **'fragile' **is **'brittle'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Brittle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Florid **(अलंकृत): Excessively intricate or elaborate.

 
 
• **Example:** The mansion was decorated in a florid style, with elaborate carvings and gold accents.
 
 
 
• **Juicy **(रसदार): Full of juice; succulent.
 
 
• **Example: **The oranges were ripe and juicy, perfect for making fresh juice.
 
 
 
• **Strong** (मजबूत): Having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks; not easily broken or damaged.
 
 
• **Example:** The strong bridge withstood the heavy load of the trucks passing over it.
